<p>If this is true (the default) then the asmprinter emits ".align N" directives, where N is the number of bytes to align to.</p>


<p>Otherwise, it emits ".align log2(N)", e.g. 3 to align to an 8 byte boundary. Defaults to true.</p>

### AllowAdditionalComments {#a17fc8ddaef7437aff31ec4b9aba7f224}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>This indicates whether to allow additional "comment strings" to be lexed as a comment.</p>


<p>Setting this attribute to true, will ensure that C-style line comments (// ..), C-style block comments (/* .. *‍/), and "#" are all treated as comments in addition to the string specified by the CommentString attribute. Default is true.</p>

<p>This is true if the assembler allows the "@" character at the start of a string to be lexed as an <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/asmtoken/#ab4316e41520ea53f789582c25bbec039a806fe218bb80f0671afdad4cec36569b">AsmToken::Identifier</a>.</p>

<p>This should be set to the directive used to get some number of zero (and non-zero if supported by the directive) bytes emitted to the current section.</p>


<p>Common cases are "\t.zero\t" and "\t.space\t". Defaults to "\t.zero\t"</p>
